concrete_defects_and_limitations.finding: The intentionally economical floor grid repeats visibly across the room; it does not interfere with objectives.
The reset trace is deliberately coarse and short rather than a rich full-screen effect; it remains unambiguous.
Still PNGs do not independently prove animation cadence or frame pacing; motion clarity is bounded by the controller-driven state sequence and captured frames.

The screenshot collector deliberately stops inside VBlank and at main-loop boundaries. Its cumulative backlog/VBlank-overrun counters therefore describe the instrumented capture session and are not used as uninterrupted performance proof; the exact same final ROM hash must separately pass the ordinary runtime and VBlank budget gates.
This M4 visual gate covers the B01 vertical slice, not the later title, sector, boss, ending, or release scenes.

A debugger-paused portable BlastEm window may retain the exact generic title `BlastEm`; those captures are accepted only with matching process ownership, ROM launch/hash and RAM provenance, a fresh PNG written by BlastEm's own ui.screenshot action into an isolated session directory, and strict known-game image-composition checks.
